title: Comparison Scan Prefix Invariant
statement: Let $y,pre,u,v$ be binary words with $y=pre\,v$. For every natural number $j\le |v|$, starting from the comparator configuration in comparison state with flag true, work word $u$, work head at zero, and input-head position $|pre|+1$, after $j$ steps it is in comparison state at input-head position $|pre|+j+1$ with work word $u$, work head at position $j$, and comparison flag true exactly when the length-$j$ prefixes of $u$ and $v$ agree.
replaced: Suppose the comparator input has the form $y = p\,v$ and let $u$ be the decoded word. For every $j \le |v|$, after $j$ steps from the comparison state at position $|p|+1$, the comparator is at position $|p|+j+1$ with its flag recording whether the length-$j$ prefixes of $u$ and $v$ agree.
